exposure: in vitro fertilization (IVF) pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
unassisted pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
cohort: 688 women with GDM (69 IVF pregnancies and 619 unassisted pregnancies)
finding: GDM in IVF pregnancies was associated with a significantly higher rate of adverse neonatal outcomes compared to unassisted pregnancies complicated by GDM, but placental histology did not differ between the groups.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the rate of cesarean deliveries between IVF pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes and unassisted pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes.
